profile: Workspace release/bench profile, global counting allocator enabled. Validation + full consumption, no serialization except named write benchmarks.
method: Initial M22 baseline before production edits, then both-order 7x300ms paired samples. Final baseline is committed M22 with identical final benchmark sources overlaid; copied binaries avoid Cargo rebuilds during timing. No throughput processes overlap.
profiles: Saved baseline sample(1ms, 6s), top-of-stack summaries + gzip raw reports. Two-second delay before sampling can include setup/warmup; profiles guide structural attribution, not timing claims.
commands: python3 benchmarks/m23/measure.py BEFORE FINAL benchmarks/m23/verification-filters.json benchmarks/m23/paired
sample BENCHMARK_PID 6 1 -file PROFILE.txt (after two-second startup delay; filters select one workload)
python3 benchmarks/m23/measure.py BEFORE FINAL benchmarks/m23/outline-filters.json benchmarks/m23/shapes
python3 benchmarks/m23/measure.py BEFORE FINAL benchmarks/m23/outline-filters.json benchmarks/m23/shapes-reverse --reverse
memory: Peak process RSS includes process and buffers/allocator high water; not exact per-frame live memory. Allocator rows report calls/requested bytes, not retained size.
limitations: No latency distributions or exact live frame byte accounting measured; RSS includes allocator high water and process/buffers.
Prototype and pre-outline data are explicitly non-final; final gains use paired medians from the retained selector.

Final forward/reverse subsets contain 30/21 selectors; matching filter prefixes can select more than one workload. Six additional final selectors run both orders; full final samples cover all 1517 workloads.
Earlier full and experimental CSVs preserve investigation provenance; they are not interchangeable with final source.
The residual tiny computed-position regression remains unexplained at instruction/layout level despite removing scanner stack overhead.
experiment: Scanner fusion first widened Path::select_context stack storage from 176 to 272 B. Outlining reduced it to 192 B, but the isolated computed-position gain did not reproduce in repository builds. An early raw-object boundary restored 176 B with negligible throughput change. The retained zero/one/multi-field selector uses 160 B and reduces the tiny computed-position loss to 2.8–3.9%; no extra scan, allocation or runtime frame was found. Native Node::run storage remains unchanged. No positional fast path is added.
reproduce_baseline: Create a separate checkout/archive of 62a4120, overlay crates/jx/benches from this milestone, then cargo bench -p jx --bench throughput --locked --no-run. Copy the exact executable Cargo reports before changing source. baseline-path.txt is local working provenance, not a required path.
